mathematical_status: Classical weighted-sum mechanism; no claim of new mathematics or universal formalization priority.

antecedent.authors: N. Bushaw, B. Cody, C. Leffler
antecedent.title: Sets of vertices with extremal energy
antecedent.relationship: The graph theorem covers distance-degree regularity and complement preservation of extrema for all potentials. This module isolates the symmetric real weighted-kernel identity on any finite type and proves equivalences for constant weighted row sums; it does not formalize all the graph theorem's equivalences or local extrema.

formal_statements: For symmetric W, E(A^c)-E(A)=E(univ)-sum_{a in A} rowSum(W,a).
Constant row sums preserve energy differences of equal-cardinality sets and transport global minimizers under complementation.
Constant row sums are equivalent to preservation of all equal-cardinality energy differences.
For symmetric W with zero diagonal, constant row sums are equivalent to complementation preserving every cardinality-constrained global minimizer.
connection_to_note5: The cycle C12 has constant interaction row sums for any distance potential. This explains the mechanism behind the note's specialized symbolic complement identity and pentatonic transport. The abstract module is a separate development; the note's theorem currently uses ExtremalityConnections.energy_compl, not an instantiated import of this module.
